items.title: Xi: Cooperation vital for global governance reform
items.description: President Xi Jinping has called for joint efforts to implement the Global Governance Initiative and build a more just and equitable global governance system, as well as a better world, bringing greater certainty and positive energy to a world marked by turbulence and change.

items.title: Xi orders all-out rescue work in Xizang
items.description: President Xi Jinping has urged all-out search and rescue efforts for the missing and prompt medical treatment for the injured, in order to minimize casualties after a magnitude 7 earthquake rocked Drachen county in Nagchu, Southwest China's Xizang autonomous region.
items.owner: JI HAISHENG in Beijing and PALDEN NYIMA in Drachen

items.title: Key meeting focuses on disciplinary inspection
items.description: The Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee held a meeting on Friday to review a report on the seventh round of disciplinary inspection launched by the 20th CPC Central Committee.

items.title: Cross-Strait fishery ties strengthened
items.description: Taiwan fishery operators expressed strong confidence in the Chinese mainland market at a ceremony held on Friday in Xiamen, Fujian province, the mainland's coastal gateway to Taiwan, marking a major step toward streamlining the entry of seafood products from the island.

items.title: Turn red legacy into local well-being
items.description: When addressing a gathering held in Beijing to mark the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Red Army's Long March, President Xi Jinping on Thursday called for new achievements on the new Long March, and underscored the need to advance high-quality development and promote common prosperity for all.

items.title: Fiscal measures expected to expand investment
items.description: China is expected to channel more fiscal resources toward bolstering investment and improving people's well-being while easing pressure on local finances, as policymakers seek to strengthen domestic demand and consolidate economic recovery in the fourth quarter, experts said on Friday.

items.description: [Photo provided to chinadaily.com.cn] The second phase of the 140th session of the China Import and Export Fair, commonly known as the Canton Fair, opened on Friday in Guangzhou, Guangdong province, focusing on quality home living products.

items.title: Cultural exchanges connect Greece and China
items.description: Greece and China, as two ancient civilizations, have long engaged in exchanges in ideas, art and trade, said Evgenios Kalpyris, Greek ambassador to China, in an interview with China Daily, adding that culture acts as a powerful medium for civilizational dialogue, creating an unbiased platform for mutual learning.

items.title: US students visit Pingyao Ancient City in Shanxi
items.description: [Photo by Zhu Xingxin/chinadaily.com.cn] A group of 13 teachers and students from George School in Langhorne, Pennsylvania, visited Pingyao Ancient City in Jinzhong, Shanxi province, to experience the unique charm of the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site, on Friday.

items.title: China issues guidelines to promote employment amid AI advances
items.description: The guidelines call for expanding employment opportunities in emerging fields, helping micro, small and medium-sized enterprises stabilize and expand employment, fostering new forms of employment and entrepreneurship in the AI sector, and developing new AI-related occupations.

items.description: The State-owned conglomerate said in a news release that the rocket blasted off at 6:15 pm from the Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center in northern China's Shanxi province and transported the Yaogan 50C satellite into its preset orbit.
